name: S3 / R2 Sync
description: Sync Recursive data to S3-compatible object storage (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Backblaze B2).

provider.name: S3 / Object Storage
provider.description: Sync to any S3-compatible object storage — AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Backblaze B2.

region.description: AWS region (e.g. us-east-1). Use 'auto' for R2.

endpoint.description: Custom endpoint URL for R2/MinIO/B2 (e.g. https://acct.r2.cloudflarestorage.com).

prefix.description: Key prefix inside the bucket (e.g. recursive-sync/). Default: recursive-sync/
